purpose: The Cmd+K palette shows the "Recent files" entry only when the query is empty or matches it, so it no longer outranks a matching command.

edits.find: if(!state)return context.mode==='commands'?[{id:'aux-file-entry',title:'Files',items:[row('aux-files-open','Recent files',{subtitle:'Downloads and files selected in this profile',actionLabel:'Open'})]},...sections]:sections;
edits.replace: if(!state){const q=query.trim().toLowerCase();return context.mode==='commands'&&(!q||'recent files downloads'.includes(q))?[{id:'aux-file-entry',title:'Files',items:[row('aux-files-open','Recent files',{subtitle:'Downloads and files selected in this profile',actionLabel:'Open'})]},...sections]:sections;}
